footer: Made with 🎄 for families who can keep a secret
error_404: This present got lost somewhere under the tree.
error_generic: Something went wrong. The elves are on it.
cal_ics_hint: iPhone, Outlook, Samsung… — draw and party with reminders
cal_draw_desc: The draw happens now. Open the party page to unwrap who you got!
cal_party_desc: Secret Santa party — don't forget your gift! 🎁
push_intro: Get a notification on this device when the draw happens, a day before the draw and the party, and when the person you drew updates their wishlist.
push_test_sent: Sent — it should arrive in a few seconds.
push_ios_install: On iPhone and iPad, notifications work in the app: tap Share → Add to Home Screen, open Secret Santa from the home screen, log in and turn them on here. If you don't see Add to Home Screen, open this page in Safari.
push_ios_not_safari: This looks like a different browser. Copy the party link and paste it into Safari — you'll enter the party code and log in once more there.
push_denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in the browser or system settings, then try again.
push_error: Couldn't turn on notifications. Try again.
push_nudge: Get notified when the draw happens
push_drawn_body: Tap to unwrap who you're getting a gift for. Make sure nobody's looking!
push_draw_soon_body: The draw is on {when}. Is your wishlist up to date?
push_draw_soon_empty: The draw is on {when} and your wishlist is still empty — add a few ideas!
push_wishlist_body: Tap to see what they'd like now.
home_lead: Create a party, invite the family with a code, set the rules and let the draw do its magic. Nobody peeks.
party_code_help: Got a code from the organiser? Type it here.
no_public_parties: No public parties yet. Have a code? Enter it above.
wizard_questions_lead: Answer a few questions and we'll write the rules for you. Anything that doesn't apply simply won't appear.
wizard_rules_lead: Here's your statute. Tweak values, reorder, remove or add more rules — you can also change it later.
wizard_you_lead: You'll be the party admin. Admins need a password.
draw_when_help: The draw happens automatically at this time.
party_public_help: Only the name and date are visible. Joining still needs the code.
code_custom_help: Letters, digits and dashes, at least 4 characters.
admin_participates: I take part in the draw too
name_help: Give your name or a nickname the family will recognise.
gate_help: This party is secret. Enter the code you got from the organiser.
created_banner: Party created! Share this code with everyone:
draw_pending: The draw is happening any moment now…
draw_problem_public: The draw is waiting for the organiser.
no_assignment: You weren't part of the draw. Ask the organiser.
cta_join_text: Join the party, write your wishlist and wait for the draw.
cta_drawn_text: Log in to see who you're giving a gift to.
no_passcode_warning: No passcode — anyone with the party code could log in as this person.
reveal_hint: Make sure nobody is looking over your shoulder!
wishlist_empty_theirs: No wishlist yet — check back later or go with your heart.
passcode_recommend: Optional, but highly recommended — it stops others from peeking at your draw.
welcome_banner: Welcome! Now write your wishlist and add a photo.
wishlist: What would you like to get?
wishlist_ph: Warm socks, a good book, anything with cats…
wishlist_help: Only the person who draws you will see this.
exclusion_title: Someone you don't want to draw
exclusion_help: Mainly for couples. It works both ways and the other person has to accept.
exclusion_incoming: asks not to draw each other
locked_after_draw: Locked — the draw has already happened.
draw_secret_note: Assignments are secret — even from you.
confirm_draw: Draw now? Joining will be closed.
confirm_reset: Reset the draw? Everyone's assignment will be lost.
code_share_help: Share it with everyone you want to invite.
code_change_note: Changing the code doesn't log anyone out, but people who haven't joined yet will need the new one.
add_member_help: For someone without a phone — you can set their wishlist later.
exclusions_admin_title: Pairs that won't draw each other
exclusions_admin_help: Pairs you add here are accepted right away.
archive_help: Archived parties are hidden from the home page and won't draw.
wishlist_spoiler_note: Hidden so you don't spoil the surprise for yourself.
passcode_admin_note: Changing or removing it logs the person out on their devices.
delete_member_note: They can join again with the code.
delete_member_drawn_note: The draw has happened — removing someone resets the draw for everyone.
confirm_delete_member_drawn: This resets the draw for everyone. Continue?
site_admin_disabled: The admin panel is disabled. Set SITE_ADMIN_PASSWORD to enable it.
site_admin_lead: All parties, including private and archived ones.
rules_empty: No rules yet. Add one below.
rule_gift_exchange_q: Does everyone prepare a gift for the person they draw?
rule_gift_exchange_s: Each participant prepares a gift for the person they drew.
rule_max_cost_q: Is there a maximum gift budget?
rule_max_cost_s: The gift should cost no more than about {amount}.
rule_secrecy_s_until_party: Don't tell anyone who you drew until the party.
rule_secrecy_s_forever: Never tell anyone who you drew — take the secret to the grave.
rule_ready_by_q: Do gifts have to be ready by a certain time?
rule_restrictions_q: Is there anything people must not buy?
rule_signed_s_recipient: Gifts must be signed with the recipient's name (but not the giver's!).
rule_signed_s_giver: Gifts must be signed with the giver's name.
rule_signed_s_both: Gifts must be signed with both the recipient's and the giver's names.
rule_follow_wishlist_q: Should people follow the recipient's wishlist?
rule_follow_wishlist_s: Try to follow the recipient's wishlist.
rule_gift_count_q: Should everyone prepare several gifts for the one person they drew?
rule_gift_count_s: Everyone prepares {n} {gifts} for the one person they drew.
rule_theme_q: Is there a theme this year?
rule_theme_ph: something cosy, books, made in Poland
rule_handover_q: Is there a special way gifts are handed over?
rule_guess_santa_q: Will everyone try to guess their Santa at the party?
rule_guess_santa_s: At the party everyone tries to guess who their Secret Santa was.
rule_gift_receipt_q: Should a gift receipt be included?
rule_gift_receipt_s: Include a gift receipt if you can, just in case.
rule_potluck_q: Does everyone bring something to the party?
err_draw_in_past: The draw date must be in the future.
err_code_format: The code needs at least 4 letters or digits (dashes allowed).
err_code_invalid: No party with this code. Check for typos.
err_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
err_name_required: Give a first name or a nickname.
err_name_taken: Someone with this name is already in the party. Add a last name or nickname.
err_join_closed: Joining is closed — the draw has already happened.
err_avatar_invalid: That doesn't look like an image.
err_avatar_too_big: The image is too large (max 10 MB).
err_locked: Locked — the draw has already happened.
err_exclusion_exists: One of you already has a pair.
err_draw_too_few: At least 2 participants are needed for the draw.
err_draw_impossible: The draw is impossible with the current pairs — remove a pair or add people.
err_last_admin: The party needs at least one admin.
